answers.moment: It was when I told him that I am a student now, at forty-four, with everybody on my course much younger. I said I am like the uncle in the library. I was a bit nervous to say it to a stranger, because some days I think I started too late. Then I said to him maybe is not too late, look at me. I meant it. For a moment we were both a bit quiet, and I think it was honest talk.
answers.reason: I would say because it is something I worry about myself. Saying it to somebody else made me feel it is true.
